item.title: Trump is threatening to block a new bridge between Detroit and Canada from opening
item.description: President Donald Trump has threatened to block the opening of a new Canadian-built bridge across the Detroit River. Trump demanded on social media Monday that Canada turn over at least half of the bridge's ownership. He also made other unspecified demands. The Gordie Howe International Bridge, expected to open in early 2026, was funded by Canada to ease congestion. Work began in 2018. Trump claims the U.S. would gain nothing from the bridge. item.title: Raiders officially hire Klint Kubiak head coach after his Super Bowl win with Seahawks
item.description: The Las Vegas Raiders announced Klint Kubiak as their head coach. Kubiak arrives fresh from a Super Bowl victory with the Seattle Seahawks. He faces key decisions, including hiring offensive and defensive coordinators. He might consider bringing coaches from Seattle. Another challenge is addressing the situation with defensive end Maxx Crosby, who reportedly wants out. item.title: Celtics All-Star Jayson Tatum will practice with G-League team on path to return
item.description: Boston All-Star Jayson Tatum took a big step toward returning from his torn Achilles tendon when he was assigned to practice with the Maine Celtics, the organization’s G-League team. The organization said he would immediately be recalled to the Boston Celtics and continue to rehab the injury he sustained in the Eastern Conference semifinals last spring. item.title: Last lawsuits against Browns QB Deshaun Watson over massages are dismissed
item.description: Cleveland Browns quarterback Deshaun Watson has had the final two of nearly 30 civil lawsuits against him dismissed. Court records show these lawsuits involved accusations of sexual misconduct from 27 women, mostly during massage appointments. The dismissals come just before the lawsuits were set to go to trial. item.description: A day after the Seattle Seahawks became Super Bowl champions, speculation about the halftime music showdown is making news. Bad Bunny was the NFL's official performer at Levi's Stadium in Santa Clara, California, but Turning Point USA put on an alternative featuring Kid Rock.
